prompt: I lost a final against Greg Rusedski on grass, who won his 4th career singles title on grass against a player that once defeated me in the opening round of the US Open. I achieved my highest ranking in singles on what date?
answer:
You were **Paradorn Srichaphan**. He lost the 2003 Nottingham final to Greg Rusedski; Taylor Dent—Rusedski’s opponent for his fourth grass-court singles title—had beaten Srichaphan in the first round of the 2003 US Open.

Srichaphan reached his career-high singles ranking of **No. 9 on May 12, 2003**.
